attchmntText: We enclose herewith the Newspaper cuttings of Business Standard (English), The Economic Times (English) and Maharashtra Times (Marathi) wherein the extract of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 were published.
We enclose herewith a Press Release issued by the Company in respect of the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today viz. Wednesday, October 28, 2026, has inter-alia, considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, subjected to Limited Review by M/s S R B C & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants, Statutory Auditors of the Company.
We enclose herewith, intimation regarding a fire incident at one of the Company's Warehouse.
We hereby inform you that a Physical Meet is scheduled to be held with the InstitutionalInvestors/Analyst Groups on Thursday, October 29, 2026 in Mumbai.

We hereby inform you that an Earnings Conference Call is scheduled to be held on Friday, October 30, 2026 in connection with the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 and on business operations of the Company. For details, please refer the attached letter.
